Palm Oil Health & Nutrition

Red edible palm oil is a very nutritious cooking oil which has been used by West Africans for years. It is known for the high contents of Vitamin E with more distinctive anti-oxidant benefits for our health.

Palm oil has been our flag ship product for export since 1995 especially for the West Africans in the diaspora as a niche product.

News

The WACOMP International Cluster Conference 2024 Exhibition.

   

The WACOMP (West Africa Competitiveness Programme) International Cluster Conference 2024 Exhibition took place on June 11, 2024, at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra, Ghana. This event was a pivotal component of the broader WACOMP Conference, which aimed to foster competitiveness and enhance value chains in West Africa.

NATIONAL CUSTOMER CHOICE AWARD

Homefoods continues to set the bar high, earning the trust and loyalty of its customers. Being recognized as the INDIGENOUS FOOD BRAND OF THE YEAR at the National Customer Choice Award 2024 held at Movenpick Ambassador Hotel on 25th October 2024, is a testament to our commitment to Quality, Innovation, and Customer Satisfaction. This award reflects the hard work, dedication, and passion of our team in delivering exceptional products and services. May this achievement inspire even greater success in the future.

Here is to more milestones and accolades!

2nd Future of Food & Beverage Manufacturing Awards 2025

Homefoods Processing and Cannery Ltd has been honored as the Best Food Processing Company of the Year at the prestigious 2nd Future of Food and Beverage Manufacturing Awards 2025, held at the Marriot Hotel on April 4, 2025. Adding to this historic achievement, Ms. Felicia Twumasi, CEO and Founder of Homefoods was named  as  the Top Future of Food and Beverage Visionary of the Year, in recognition of her groundbreaking leadership and transformative vision in the industry.
